author: agent:claude-code
message: The user's call on PJRT for Windows: keep the JAX path for now, as a provisional decision with what would reopen it.

title: XLA on Windows stays through JAX (provisional)
body: Provisional, to revisit: flux reaches XLA on Windows through JAX in a Python process of its own (the Xla backend), rather than building XLA's //xla/pjrt/c:pjrt_c_api_cpu_plugin for Windows to use the pure-Rust Pjrt path there. Options: (a) keep JAX, nothing to build, Python needed at run time; (b) build the plugin, Python-free, but a Bazel build of XLA on Windows to maintain. Chose (a) for now. Revisit when a Windows PJRT plugin is published, or when a Windows deployment needs XLA without Python (the waiting todo 'Revisit: XLA on Windows without Python').

title: Revisit: XLA on Windows without Python
body: The provisional decision 'XLA on Windows stays through JAX' holds until one of these comes: a published Windows PJRT plugin (then use Pjrt there and supersede the decision), or a Windows deployment that needs XLA without Python (then build the plugin).

waits_on.on: a published Windows PJRT plugin, or a Windows deployment needing XLA without Python
